stock.description: Million Cities Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding enterprise, with its principal activities centered on real estate development and sales within the People's Republic of China. The company's primary focus is on the construction of residential properties, which often incorporate integrated ancillary facilities. Beyond development, it also markets its completed projects, leases out both developed and available properties including retail units and kindergartens, and offers property management services. Established in 2003, the firm is based in Tai Po, Hong Kong, and functions as a subsidiary of Happy Family Trust.
